name: Claude
about: The unified proposal: the studio's navy look, one accent, one selection colour, one playhead, sans UI text with monospace numbers. Every other skin extends this one.

name: Paper
about: Modern and light-first: warm off-white paper, near-black ink, one terracotta accent, soft shadows instead of borders, generous radii, serif headings over a clean sans, drafting-paper canvases. Second mode: night, in warm darks.

name: 90s
about: Desktop software, 1995-1999: grey bevels, navy title bars, Tahoma, dithered toggles, the 16 VGA colours, a white map like the old DOOM editors and green-on-black waveforms. Two modes: classic, and night (a high-contrast scheme).

name: PS1
about: Late-90s 3D console menus: blue gradient windows with a bright rim, white pixel text with hard shadows, a gold cursor, dithered gradients, faint scanlines, memory-card blocks for progress. Modes: dark (the TV at night) and console (grey plastic).
